## Welcome to Shortcuts Viewer!

This is your personal shortcuts reference. Edit this text to add your own shortcuts and notes.

## Example Shortcuts

### System
Win+D : Show desktop
Win+E : Open File Explorer
Win+I : Open Settings
Ctrl+Shift+Esc : Task Manager

### Browser Shortcuts (included)
Win+Shift+I : AI Services Menu
Win+Shift+U : Open URL or Search
Win+Shift+T : Translate text
Ctrl+Shift+C : Copy without Markdown

### This Tool
Win+Shift+/ : Open this shortcuts viewer
Shift+Win+V : Toggle sleep mode
